rationale: Every field that may legitimately differ between two runs is enumerated here with its kind and its reason. Anything else that varies is a defect. Declaring volatility explicitly is the whole point: a checker that diffs artifacts and ignores 'timestamp-looking' fields by pattern will also ignore a genuinely non-deterministic field that happens to be named like a date.

placeholders.{python}: the interpreter running the checker, so the child is the same runtime
placeholders.{scratch}: a per-run temporary directory outside the repository

generators.description: Static analysis output. Contains no time and no entropy, so it must be byte-identical across runs with nothing declared volatile.
Allowlist verdict over a fixed fixture. Also fully determined by its input.
generators.expected_exit_code_reason: The guard is a gate and exits 1 on the out-of-allowlist fixture. Its report must still be byte-identical across runs.

generators.description: Durable-sink round-trip proof written by the coordinator's control plane.

volatile_fields.reason: UTC second at which the canary was written.
SHA-256 over worker id, current time and process id. Deliberately unique per attempt so a replayed canary cannot be mistaken for a fresh round-trip.

generators.description: The result document every PO-03 unit commits. The class whose determinism matters most, because a reviewer must be able to regenerate it and get the same custody claims.

volatile_fields.reason: UTC second the attempt last reported liveness.
UTC second the result transaction was committed.
UTC second the artifacts were verified by hash.
UTC second each artifact was read back and hashed.

fixture_generators.description: Planted defect: emits an undeclared varying field. The checker must report it. A determinism checker that has never caught a non-deterministic generator is not evidence.

volatile_fields.reason: Declared volatile so the test proves detection of the undeclared field beside it, not merely of any variance at all.

fixture_generators.description: Control fixture: same shape, no variance at all. Proves the checker does not simply fail everything.
